title: Sample 17-1: Spelling List

illustrates.quote: b. List spelling words vertically using 1-3 margins. c. Contract the first writing of the spelling word or phrase. d. Repeat the words/phrases in uncontracted braille. e. Leave one blank cell between the contracted and uncontracted words.

print.notes: Two centred (blue, sans-serif in print) headings, then an italic spelling word list; each word is given contracted, then (only where the contracted form actually differs from the plain spelling) uncontracted.
print.printFeatures: Two centred blue headings above an italic word list.

braille.notes: A's braille.lines kept (matches source exactly, including the trailing blank content line, source line 13886, before '(Return to Text)'); B dropped that trailing blank line — a genuine, source-verifiable omission shared by neither run alone.

resolution: Both runs (A, B) came from the same model (Gemini Pro via Antigravity, 17 Sep 2026) and are not independent; agreement was treated as no evidence. braille.lines independently re-extracted from references/_text/braille-formats-2016.txt (the line-number field, digits + >=3 spaces, or the fixed left margin measured in ASCII spaces before any U+2800 cell, stripped by counting; U+2800->space; trailing spaces removed). Braille: A's version (with the trailing blank line the source genuinely carries, confirmed against line 13886) kept over B's (missing it). Rule id unchanged (both agreed '17.2.2', matches the source's own cross-reference at the end of clause g). Modeled as a 'list' whose items give the plain spelling once where print's own word has no distinct contraction (favorite, sidewalk, slide, globe — confirmed by the given braille itself showing only one copy) and BOTH the contracted and (backtick) uncontracted spelling where the given braille shows two (brain/stranger/bowling/whole) — 17.2.2c/d/e's own dual-writing convention, standards-map.md 'done'.
